products.name: Alteryx AI
products.note: Analytics automation with AI; data blending; workflow governance; self-service analytics risk

profile_text.body:
Alteryx is a data and analytics company that describes itself as providing AI-ready analytics automation for enterprise organizations. Its platform, Alteryx One, is positioned as a full-spectrum analytics solution that connects to enterprise systems including Oracle, Microsoft, Snowflake, and Databricks, allowing users to prepare and blend data using low-code and no-code workflows while maintaining governance, lineage, and controls. The company states that predictive analytics automation on the platform can save up to 170 FTE hours a month.

Alteryx's primary AI product, tracked on this site as Alteryx AI, combines predictive analytics, machine learning, and generative AI capabilities within the Alteryx One platform. The company describes its approach as enabling business users with domain expertise to build automated data workflows without requiring handoffs to technical teams. The company cites McLaren Racing and Nielsen among its customers, with Nielsen using Alteryx as the core solution for a business intelligence overhaul. Alteryx describes itself as rated a leader across multiple 2026 analyst evaluations for advanced analytics and AI at enterprise scale.

No litigation, patent filings, SEC records, or MCP server registrations are present in the held facts for this company.
